Because q1 produced no seeds, q2 (mitigations) was skipped as a dependency failure. The narrative/abstention text ('the executed query ran cleanly and returned no matching records') is technically accurate about what happened and introduces no fabricated ids, counts, or names, so there is no faithfulness violation and the abstention trace is fully grounded in the logic_flow — but the answer completely fails the question: it surfaces none of the required CAPEC ids, none of the 14 ATT&CK techniques, and none of the 19 mitigations, and its correlation/mapping_recall scores in the artifact itself confirm recall=0.0 against 14 expected techniques. This is a retrieval/query-construction bug producing a false 'no data' impression rather than a genuine negative case, so it is graded INCORRECT.
